senses.gloss:
Sadhri is the name of a Ṛṣi in the Rigveda.^1
1) v. 44, 10. Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 139.

Sādhāraṇī in one passage of the Rigveda^1 seems to refer not
so much to an uxor communis, like Draupadī in the Epic, as
Max Müller^2 suggests, but to a courtezan.
1) i. 167, 4.
2) Sacred Books of the East, 32, 277.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 332;
Muir, Sanskrit Texts, 5, 461; Pischel
and Geldner, Vedische Studien, 1, xxv.
